## 2. Preprocess the Data

### Clean the data

```{r}

```

We remove integrated since it is just negation of dedicated

```{r}
num_from_string <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(x, "[0-9.]+"))
}

num_mhz  <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # MHz
num_watt <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # W
num_mb   <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # MB
num_gb   <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # GB
num_nm   <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # nm
num_usd  <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # US$
num_kb   <- function(x) num_from_string(x)          # kb$


extract_psu <- function(x, part = c("watt", "amp")) {
  part <- match.arg(part)
  pattern <- if (part == "watt") "(\\d+)\\s*Watt" else "(\\d+)\\s*Amp"
  as.numeric(str_extract(x, pattern) %>% str_remove_all("(Watt|Amp|s|\\s)"))
}
```

```{r}
## ---- 06-main-munging-pipeline ----------------------------------------------
# Rationale : Apply the rules given in the project brief, one mutate block keeps
#             the column–wise transformations explicit and auditable.

gpu_tidy <- gpu_data %>% 
  
  mutate(
    best_resolution      = factor(best_resolution),
    resolution_wx_h      = factor(resolution_wx_h),
    manufacturer      = factor(manufacturer),
    sli_crossfire      = factor(sli_crossfire),
    boost_clock          = num_mhz(boost_clock),
    boostable        = factor(!is.na(boost_clock), levels = c(TRUE, FALSE),
                              labels = c("Yes", "No")),
    core_speed           = num_mhz(na_if(core_speed, "-")),
    dvi_connection          = as.integer(dvi_connection),
    display_port_connection = as.integer(display_port_connection),
    hdmi_connection         = as.integer(hdmi_connection),
    vga_connection          = as.integer(vga_connection),
    dedicated            = factor(dedicated),
    notebook_gpu         = factor(notebook_gpu),
    direct_x         = factor(num_from_string(direct_x)),
    shader           = as.integer(num_from_string(shader)),
    open_gl          = as.numeric(open_gl),
    max_power            = num_watt(max_power),
    memory               = num_mb(memory),                    # MB
    memory_bandwidth = case_when(
                          is.na(memory_bandwidth)                 ~ NA_real_,
                          str_detect(memory_bandwidth, "MB/sec") ~
                              num_from_string(memory_bandwidth) / 1024,
                          TRUE                                    ~
                              num_from_string(memory_bandwidth)
                       ),
    memory_speed         = num_mhz(memory_speed),
    memory_bus           = factor(memory_bus),
    memory_type          = factor(memory_type),
    l2_cache = case_when(
                 is.na(l2_cache)                     ~ NA_real_,
                 stringr::str_detect(l2_cache, "\\(x") ~ {
                     base <- num_kb(l2_cache)
                     mult <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(l2_cache,
                                                             "(?<=x)\\d+"))
                     base * mult
                 },
                 TRUE                                ~ num_kb(l2_cache)
               ),
    max_power            = as.integer(max_power),
    pixel_rate       = num_from_string(pixel_rate),
    texture_rate     = num_from_string(texture_rate),
    process              = as.integer(num_nm(process)),
    
    ro_ps = case_when(
              is.na(ro_ps)                       ~ NA_real_,
              str_detect(ro_ps, "\\(x")          ~ {
                 base <- num_from_string(ro_ps)
                 mult <- as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(ro_ps, "(?<=x)\\d+"))
                 base * mult
              },
              TRUE                               ~ num_from_string(ro_ps)
            ),
    
    psu_watt             = extract_psu(psu, "watt"),
    psu_amp              = extract_psu(psu, "amp"),
    
    power_connector      = factor(power_connector, exclude = NULL),
    
    release_date  = lubridate::dmy(ifelse(release_date == "Unknown Release Date", 
                                          NA, release_date)),
    release_year  = lubridate::year(release_date),
    
    release_price = num_usd(release_price)
  ) %>% 
  relocate(name, manufacturer, architecture,
           release_date, release_year, release_price)

```

```{r}

## ── 1.  Drop the requested columns ───────────────────────────────────────
gpu_clean <- gpu_tidy %>%                 # start from your tibble
  select(                                  # keep everything *except* …
    -name,
    -architecture,
    -psu,
    -release_date,
    -best_resolution,
    -boost_clock,
    -psu_watt,
    -psu_amp,
  )

## ── 2.  Replace the specified NA values  ─────────────────────────────────
gpu_clean <- gpu_clean %>%
  ## dedicated  (factor)  → NA  ⇒  "No"
  mutate(
    dedicated = factor(
      if_else(is.na(dedicated), "No", as.character(dedicated)),
      levels = c("No", "Yes")     # keep the original level order
    )
  ) %>%
  ## All the other variables (numeric / integer)  → NA  ⇒  0
  mutate(
    across(
      c(dvi_connection, display_port_connection, hdmi_connection,
        vga_connection, open_gl, shader, ro_ps, tm_us),
      ~ replace_na(., 0)
    )
  )

```

```{r}
skim(gpu_clean)
```

```{r}
gpu_filtered <- gpu_clean %>%          # after the previous steps
#  filter(!is.na(core_speed)) %>%        # keep only rows with core_speed present
 
  # 1.  DROP rows whose memory is NA while the GPU is dedicated
  filter(!(is.na(memory) & dedicated == "Yes")) %>% 
  
  # 2.  For the remaining rows, turn the still-missing memory values
  #     (these are all non-dedicated GPUs) into 0
  mutate(memory = replace_na(memory, 0))
skim(gpu_filtered)
```

### Inspect on missing pattern

```{r}
gpu_check_missing_pattern <- gpu_tidy %>% 
  mutate(miss_release_price = is.na(release_price))

gg_missing_price <- gpu_check_missing_pattern %>% 
  group_by(release_year) %>% 
  summarise(prop_missing = mean(miss_release_price, na.rm = TRUE),
            n_obs        = n()) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = release_year, y = prop_missing)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of missing release_price by release year",
       x     = "Release year",
       y     = "% missing (release_price)") +
  theme_minimal()

print(gg_missing_price)


```

I am in doubt that

```{r}
gpu_num <- gpu_check_missing_pattern %>% 
  select(release_price, release_year) %>%  # add other numeric vars if desired
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric)) # ensure numeric class

mcar_res <- naniar::mcar_test(gpu_num)
print(mcar_res)
```

Little’s MCAR test (χ² = 430.4, df = 2, p \< 0.001) provides strong evidence that release_price is not missing completely at random; missingness is strongly related to release_year. Subsequent modelling and imputations therefore control for release_year to satisfy the weaker MAR assumption.

We decide to treat the missing of release_price as MAR.

Now, decide which predictors enter the imputation model. We decide to use every variable that is:

a) available **before** price is known (no post-treatment bleeding),
b) has ≤ 50 % missingness,
c) plausibly related to price (performance, manufacturer, launch date …).

```{r}
# ── 3  Specify MICE methods & predictor matrix  ───────────────────
# a) start from the default method vector produced by mice
meth <- make.method(gpu)

# b) tell mice which algorithm to use for each type
num_vars    <- names(which(sapply(gpu, is.numeric)))
fact_vars   <- names(which(sapply(gpu, is.factor)))

meth[num_vars]  <- "pmm"                 # predictive mean matching
meth[fact_vars] <- ifelse(sapply(gpu[fact_vars], nlevels) == 2,
                          "logreg",      # binary factors
                          "polyreg")     # > 2 levels

# c) exclude release_price completely
meth["release_price"] <- ""              # empty string ⇒ leave as is

# d) create predictor matrix programmatically
pred <- quickpred(gpu,
                  exclude = "release_price",   # do not predict / be predicted by it
                  mincor  = 0.05,              # drop very weakly correlated vars
                  method  = "pearson")         # numeric & polyserial correlations

# ensure release_price is not used anywhere
pred[ , "release_price"] <- 0
```

```{r}
# ── 4  Run the MICE engine  ───────────────────────────────────────
imp_gpu <- mice(data      = gpu,
                m         = 5,      # five parallel imputed data sets
                maxit     = 20,     # iterations per chain
                method    = meth,
                predictorMatrix = pred,
                seed      = 1234,
                printFlag = TRUE)

# Convergence diagnostic
plot(imp_gpu, layout = c(3, 4))
```

```{r}
Mode <- function(x) {
  ux <- na.omit(unique(x))
  ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))]
}

# ── 5  Extract one completed data set keeping release_price as is ─
gpu_complete <- complete(imp_gpu, action = "long") %>%     # long format (m × n rows)
  group_by(.id) %>%                                        # .id = original row number
  summarise(across(everything(), 
                   ~ if(is.numeric(.x)) mean(.x) else Mode(.x))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>%                                            # ← our single “average” data set
  select(-.id)                                             # drop helper column

# bring back the original order of variables
gpu_complete <- gpu_complete[ names(gpu) ]
```

```{r}
# ── 6  Centre & scale numeric predictors (optional but recommended) ─
num_pred <- setdiff(num_vars, "release_price")  # do NOT touch price column

pre_model <- preProcess(gpu_complete[ , num_pred], 
                        method = c("center", "scale"))

gpu_final <- gpu_complete          # copy
gpu_final[ , num_pred] <- predict(pre_model, gpu_complete[ , num_pred])

# quick check
summary(gpu_final[ , num_pred][1:5])
```
